title: A task from start to finish
desc: You say what you want. The AI reads the project first, and each finding cites the code. It writes a plan, which fresh AIs check; a question in the plan goes to the advisor. It cuts the plan into small tickets. For each ticket: the tests are written and locked first, and the AI builds until it scores 70%, each time from its best try. After 3 tries, it asks the advisor: a second AI, or you. The gate passes the change, and it is merged; you merge the risky ones. After the last ticket, a review reads the whole task. You read the report, and up to 3 lessons become rules for the next task.
